ElectronicsItem.title: ElectronicsItem
ElectronicsItem.description: An electronic product inventory record with pricing, stock level, specs, and status.

userId.description: UID of the merchant who owns this inventory item

sku.description: Stock Keeping Unit or barcode string

category.description: Electronics category (e.g. Smartphones, Audio, Laptops, Accessories)

costPrice.description: Unit purchase / wholesale cost in dollars

sellingPrice.description: Unit retail selling price in dollars

condition.description: Condition of device (New, Refurbished, Open Box, Used)

location.description: Shelf, aisle, or bin storage location

createdAt.description: Timestamp of creation; clients must pass serverTimestamp

updatedAt.description: Timestamp of last update; clients must pass serverTimestamp

StockLog.title: StockLog
StockLog.description: Audit record of inventory level changes with staff attribution.

id.description: Unique identifier of the log entry

itemId.description: ID of the inventory item affected

itemName.description: Snapshot of item name at time of adjustment

reason.description: Reason for adjustment (Restock, Sale, Return, Damage, Audit)

staffName.description: Name of the staff member who performed the action

staffRole.description: Role of the staff member (Owner, Manager, Sales, Clerk)

createdAt.description: Timestamp of the transaction; clients must pass serverTimestamp

StaffMember.title: StaffMember
StaffMember.description: A store employee profile with password and assigned role (Owner, Manager, Sales, Clerk).

id.description: Unique identifier of the staff member

role.description: Assigned permission role (OWNER, MANAGER, SALES, CLERK)

pin.description: Password or PIN code for staff login

isActive.description: Whether staff account is currently active

/users/{userId}/items/{itemId}.description: Electronics inventory catalog items for the authenticated store

/users/{userId}/stock_logs/{logId}.description: Stock change history logs with staff attribution

/users/{userId}/staff/{staffId}.description: Store staff profiles with passwords and roles
